input.rationale: Section 9(b) contains an express Kubient performance warranty that meets or exceeds the preferred position: the Service "will perform in all material respects to industry standards" (p0034), services "shall be free from errors that materially affect their utility" (p0038), the product and service "shall be free of any viruses, Trojan Horses, worms..." (p0036), and Kubient warrants compliance with all applicable Laws throughout the Term (p0041). Duration is better than preferred — these warranties run for the whole Term rather than a 90-day/12-month window. The "as is" disclaimer in Section 13 does not swallow the express warranty: it applies only "Except as expressly set forth herein" and "except for the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement" (p0062). The clause does not spell out a repair/replace/refund remedy, but no exclusive-remedy limitation is imposed either, so we retain all contractual remedies (including termination for uncured material breach under Section 4(b)) — a better outcome for us than the capped preferred remedy. That sub-element is noted, not flagged.
